messages.content: not sure what to do at night, I want to stay up and meditate sitting down and not sleeping

> Practice-timing guidance: night meditation is possible but practice-dependent — energising breath/mantra work done at night can keep you awake for hours; dulling practices clouded by sleepiness lose clarity benefits. Recommendation: if a night practice helps you sleep, still sit once during the day to get the awake benefits; late-night sitting works when deliberately used to stay up (overnight drives, exams).
> — [teacher-answer] why night meditation bites back (practice-timing guidance) :: https://www.artofliving.org/us-en/blog/can-not-sleep-why-meditation-at-night-might-be-keeping-you-up-late

You said: *"I want to stay up and meditate sitting down and not sleeping."* Is that wanting a pull toward the sitting, or a push away from sleep — and can you feel which of those it is right now?
